name: Opacity Modulating Parameter for Surfel Optimization
definition: A technique to solve the non-differentiability of optimizing opaque surfel geometry from image color loss by using a gradual opacity modulation parameter $w_i$ to evolve translucent surfels into opaque ones.
summary: It is a parameter that evolves translucent surfels into opaque ones, differing from standard 2D Gaussian Evaluation by controlling the transition from soft Gaussian profiles to hard-edged discs.
